question: Who among the following was considered to be the queen of Thumri?
solution:
The correct answer is __Girija Devi__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Girija Devi was an Indian classical singer of the Seniya and Banaras gharanas.
 
• She performed classically and light classical music and helped elevate the profile of thumri.
 
• Girija Devi is also known as 'The Queen of Thumri'.
 
• Thumri is North India's most popular light-classical song form.
 
• It is developed during the 19th century at the court of Lucknow's ruler Wajid Ali Shah.​​
